## New or updated pack

**Pack id:** `packs/<id>/`
**What's in it:**

- [ ] I made this art myself (no copyrighted characters, logos or brands)
- [ ] It's friendly for everyone's desktop
- [ ] It passes in [Pack Studio](https://x-salmon.github.io/shellby-packs/studio/) with no warnings
- [ ] If I updated an existing pack, I bumped its `version`
- [ ] I agree to publish this pack under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

**After it merges:** you will get a comment with a picture of Shellby wearing your pack and one-click links to post it. Please share it and tag #ShellbyPacks; that is how people find new packs.
